    // x rounded to the nearest whole value, halves rounding up (toward +infinity),
    // via Floor(x + 1/2). Note: deliberately half-up, unlike the host intrinsic
    // Round (typically banker's rounding) — do not "simplify" to Round.
    RoundedToNearest(x: IReal): IReal
        => (x + x.One.Half).Floor;
